title: Baklava Turkish Classic

description: Indulge in the rich, sweet flavors of Turkish Baklava, a classic dessert featuring layers of crispy phyllo pastry, finely chopped nuts, and a fragrant, sweet syrup. This authentic recipe guides you through creating a truly memorable treat that is perfect for any special occasion or simply to enjoy with a cup of Turkish tea.

instructions.title: Prepare the Syrup
instructions.text: In a medium saucepan, combine the sugar and water. Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring until the sugar dissolves. Reduce heat and simmer for 10-15 minutes until slightly thickened. Remove from heat, stir in the lemon juice, and let it cool completely. The syrup must be cold when poured over the hot baklava.

instructions.title: Prepare the Nuts and Butter
instructions.text: Finely chop the pistachios or walnuts. If desired, mix with cinnamon and cloves. Melt the butter in a small saucepan. Skim off any foam from the top and discard the milky solids at the bottom, leaving only clarified butter (ghee). This ensures the baklava stays crisp.

instructions.title: Layer the Phyllo Dough
instructions.text: Preheat your oven to 325°F (160°C). Brush a 9x13 inch baking pan generously with clarified butter. Lay one sheet of phyllo dough in the pan, carefully pressing it down. Brush lightly with butter. Repeat this process for 10-12 sheets, layering and buttering each sheet individually.

instructions.title: Add Nut Filling and Continue Layering
instructions.text: Evenly spread half of the chopped nut mixture over the buttered phyllo layers. Place another 8-10 sheets of phyllo on top of the nuts, buttering each sheet as before. Spread the remaining nut mixture over these layers. Finish by layering the remaining 18-20 phyllo sheets, buttering each one.

instructions.title: Cut and Bake the Baklava
instructions.text: Using a sharp knife, carefully cut the baklava into diamond or square shapes, cutting all the way through to the bottom of the pan. Pour any remaining clarified butter evenly over the top. Bake in the preheated oven for 30-35 minutes, or until golden brown and puffed.

instructions.title: Pour Syrup and Serve
instructions.text: Immediately after removing the hot baklava from the oven, slowly and evenly pour the completely cold syrup over the entire pan. You will hear a sizzling sound. Let the baklava sit at room temperature for at least 4 hours, or preferably overnight, to allow the syrup to fully soak into the layers. Garnish with additional chopped pistachios if desired before serving.

tips: Ensure your syrup is completely cold and the baklava is hot when combined; this contrast is key to a crispy texture.
Use clarified butter (ghee) for the best results. It prevents the baklava from becoming soggy and gives it a beautiful golden color.
Do not rush the resting time after adding the syrup. Allowing it to soak for several hours or overnight is crucial for the perfect flavor and texture.
